technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25) in any one year Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor at least one similar work such as of value not less than Rs 26.09 Lakhs (Certified Not less than the ranking of EE)

The bidder should have executed the following quantity of items in any one continuous year Earthwork688.93 Cum, All type of Cement Concrete241.68cum, Steel reinforcement and Structural Steel 7.92 t, Masonry (SSM/BBM/Solid Block) Work226.48 Sqm

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2020-21 to 2024-25 achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs 61.63 Lakhs
